Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent eight-frame looping FIRE PARTICLE sprite sheet, for a dark cyberpunk/occult roguelike using native 64px cells.
Input image 1 is only the approved character's crisp comic-art style reference. Input image 2 is only the painted fire palette and edge reference. Draw no character, robe, scene, weapon or scenery.
Primary request: one SMALL HORIZONTAL rushing flame tuft in eight successive loop frames, meant to be emitted many times to compose a flamethrower stream. This is a standalone complete small piece of fire, NOT a whole cone, explosion, or flame wall.
Shape: an irregular elongated flame puff, approximately twice as wide as tall, travelling LEFT TO RIGHT. A compact warm ivory/yellow hot core on its LEFT half, orange body, darker burnt-orange scalloped lower edge, several pointed licking tongues tapering to the RIGHT. Every frame keeps the SAME centre and overall size; tips and inner flame masses visibly change in a seamless loop. Small asymmetrical solid colour masses, restrained thin dark edges. Each tuft remains compact and fully self-contained with no distant floating sparks.
Style: hand-painted/inked comic game art, compact decisive colour masses, subtle flat facets as in the character, vivid orange and warm yellow, strong readable organic silhouette at 40–64px. The warm opaque flame itself carries the effect. Not a soft luminous ball.
Exact composition: 4 columns by 2 rows of equal SQUARE cells, 2:1 overall sheet. Eight chronological frames, left-to-right then next row. Each tuft centred at 50% x, 50% y in its cell, occupies 76% of cell width and 38% of cell height. Leave empty transparent gutters on all four sides. Every whole flame and its tips inside its own cell.
Output: true transparent background, original alpha. No grid marks, labels, border, text or watermark.
Avoid: giant fire fan, triangular cone, upright candle, smoke cloud, large detached sparks, circles, geometric ribbons, neon glow, fuzzy halos, photography, backgrounds, excessive texture, separate scene components.
